description: This file defines a Java class OrangeHrmApiClient that acts as a wrapper for API interactions with the OrangeHRM system during automation testing. It provides methods for authenticating as an admin and creating request specifications with proper authentication cookies.

classes.name: OrangeHrmApiClient
classes.description: A final class providing an API client wrapper to facilitate authentication and request creation for OrangeHRM API automation testing.

methods.name: OrangeHrmApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API client with configuration data.

methods.name: authenticateAsAdmin
methods.description: Authenticates against the API using provided admin credentials and stores session cookies for authenticated requests.

methods.name: baseSpec
methods.description: Builds and returns a base request specification with the base URL and JSON acceptance content type.

methods.name: authedSpec
methods.description: Builds and returns a request specification including session cookies for authenticated API calls.
